q.en: Who is the boss of your body?
q.hg: Tumhari body ka boss kaun hai?

explain.en: Your body belongs to you. You can say no to a touch you do not like and tell a grown-up you trust.
explain.hg: Tumhari body tumhari hai. Jo touch tumhe achha na lage, use tum NO bol sakte ho aur kisi trusted bade ko bata sakte ho.

q.en: Where are egg cells stored in the body?
q.hg: Body mein egg cells kahan store rehte hain?

explain.en: The two ovaries, one on each side of the uterus, store the egg cells and also make the hormone oestrogen.
explain.hg: Uterus ke dono side ek-ek ovary hoti hai; inhi mein egg cells store rehte hain aur yahi oestrogen hormone bhi banati hain.

q.en: Which group of hormones causes pubic and underarm hair to grow in all genders?
q.hg: Kaun se hormones har gender mein pubic aur underarm hair grow karwate hain?

explain.en: Androgens are testosterone-type hormones. Every body makes them, and they trigger pubic and underarm hair as well as oilier skin.
explain.hg: Androgens testosterone-type hormones hain. Har body inhe banati hai, aur inhi se pubic aur underarm hair aate hain aur skin zyada oily hoti hai.

q.hg: Semen kis cheez se bana hota hai?

options.hg: Urine aur sperm ke mix se

options.en: Sperm mixed with fluids from the seminal vesicles and the prostate
options.hg: Sperm aur seminal vesicles aur prostate ke fluids ke mix se

options.en: A fluid made in the bladder
options.hg: Bladder mein banne wale fluid se

explain.en: Sperm from the testes are only a small part of semen. Most of it is fluid added by the seminal vesicles and the prostate gland.
explain.hg: Testes se aaye sperm semen ka bas chhota sa part hote hain. Zyadatar hissa woh fluid hai jo seminal vesicles aur prostate gland add karte hain.

q.en: The inside of the vagina needs to be washed with soap to stay clean.
q.hg: Vagina ko clean rakhne ke liye use andar se soap se wash karna zaroori hai.

explain.en: The vagina cleans itself with a slightly acidic fluid and helpful bacteria. Soap or sprays inside disturb that balance; only the vulva needs gentle washing.
explain.hg: Vagina halke acidic fluid aur helpful bacteria ki madad se khud ko clean rakhti hai. Andar soap ya sprays use karne se woh balance bigadta hai; sirf vulva ko gently wash karna kaafi hai.

q.en: Meera is 16 and has not had her first period, though her classmates started years ago. What is the best next step?
q.hg: Meera 16 saal ki hai aur use ab tak pehla period nahi aaya, jabki uski classmates ko saalon pehle aa gaya tha. Best next step kya hai?

options.en: See a doctor, because no period by 15 should be checked
options.hg: Doctor ko dikhana, kyunki 15 saal tak period na aaye toh check hona chahiye

options.en: Wait until 18, since late periods run in some families
options.hg: 18 saal tak wait karna, kyunki kuch families mein periods late aate hain

options.en: Take hormone tablets bought from a chemist
options.hg: Chemist se hormone ki tablets lekar khana

options.en: Eat papaya and jaggery every day to bring it on
options.hg: Period laane ke liye roz papita aur gud khana

explain.en: No period by 15 is a reason to see a doctor. Most causes are manageable, but they need proper tests, not waiting, home remedies or self-medication.
explain.hg: 15 saal tak period na aana doctor ko dikhane ka reason hai. Zyadatar causes manage ho sakte hain, par uske liye proper tests chahiye, na ki wait, gharelu nuskhe ya khud se dawai.
